# The building this location would give up most cheaply, and which good it is.

# `-1` in `_esw` means "nothing here may be taken out at all" -- every building
# is either its good's last on the ground or part of the town's charter bundle.
# **A gain of nought is a real answer and `-1` is not**, which is why the empty
# marker cannot be nought: a good the ground feeds nothing is exactly the one an
# edit should be taking out first.

				# is `_lock<n>` and not `_skip<n>`: «не нужен» says «never fill this

				# **Two different locks meet on this line and they are not the same
				# thing.** `_edit_locked_<n>` above is the charter's: this building
				# belongs to a town right's bundle and the bundle goes whole or not at
				# all. `_lock<n>` here is the player's: he pressed this good and it
				# stays where he put it.
				#
				# **A good the player pinned is never the one that gives way.** The
				# second of the lock's three consequences: pressing «+1» on iron must
				# not quietly undo the «−1» he spent on cloth a moment ago. Note this
				# is `_lock<n>` and not `_skip<n>`: «не нужен» says «never fill this
				# past its minimum», which makes its buildings *better* candidates to
				# give up, not protected ones.
				NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock26 }
				# **The good that gave way is the one furthest above its share, and
				# its cheapest building is the one that goes.** Step 3, and it is
				# the eviction side of the rule the fill already obeys: «−1» hands
				# a freed room to the good furthest *below* its share.
				#
				# **Two keys and one pass, exactly as the fill does it** -- `_esx`
				# carries the best excess so far and `_esw` the gain that goes with
				# it, so «more bloated» and «as bloated but cheaper to lose» are two
				# arms of one `OR`. Not a packed `превышение × K + выгода`: the
				# engine's fixed-point limit is not known from here, and the same
				# warning already stands over `_plan_order`.

				# On the strict pass a good at or below its share is not a victim
				# at all. `bag_wtp_edit_add` runs the scan strict first and repeats
				# it open only if nothing qualified, so this narrows and never blocks.

					global_var:bag_wtp_edit_strict = 0
					global_var:bag_wtp_exs26 > 0

							var:bag_wtp_esw = -1
							var:bag_wtp_pr26 < var:bag_wtp_esw
						}
					}
				}

				global_var:bag_wtp_pn35 > 1
				NOT = { bag_wtp_edit_locked_35 = yes }
				# **Two different locks meet on this line and they are not the same
				# thing.** `_edit_locked_<n>` above is the charter's: this building
				# belongs to a town right's bundle and the bundle goes whole or not at
				# all. `_lock<n>` here is the player's: he pressed this good and it
				# stays where he put it.
				#
				# **A good the player pinned is never the one that gives way.** The
				# second of the lock's three consequences: pressing «+1» on iron must
				# not quietly undo the «−1» he spent on cloth a moment ago. Note this
				# is `_lock<n>` and not `_skip<n>`: «не нужен» says «never fill this
				# past its minimum», which makes its buildings *better* candidates to
				# give up, not protected ones.
				NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock35 }
				# **The good that gave way is the one furthest above its share, and
				# its cheapest building is the one that goes.** Step 3, and it is
				# the eviction side of the rule the fill already obeys: «−1» hands
				# a freed room to the good furthest *below* its share.
				#
				# **Two keys and one pass, exactly as the fill does it** -- `_esx`
				# carries the best excess so far and `_esw` the gain that goes with
				# it, so «more bloated» and «as bloated but cheaper to lose» are two
				# arms of one `OR`. Not a packed `превышение × K + выгода`: the
				# engine's fixed-point limit is not known from here, and the same
				# warning already stands over `_plan_order`.
				#
				# On the strict pass a good at or below its share is not a victim
				# at all. `bag_wtp_edit_add` runs the scan strict first and repeats
				# it open only if nothing qualified, so this narrows and never blocks.
				OR = {
					global_var:bag_wtp_edit_strict = 0
					global_var:bag_wtp_exs35 > 0
				}

					var:bag_wtp_esx < global_var:bag_wtp_exs35
					AND = {
						var:bag_wtp_esx = global_var:bag_wtp_exs35
						OR = {
							var:bag_wtp_esw = -1
							var:bag_wtp_pr35 < var:bag_wtp_esw
						}
					}
				}
			}

			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esw value = var:bag_wtp_pr43 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esg value = 43 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:steel }
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn44 > 1
				NOT = { bag_wtp_edit_locked_44 = yes }
				# **Two different locks meet on this line and they are not the same
				# thing.** `_edit_locked_<n>` above is the charter's: this building
				# belongs to a town right's bundle and the bundle goes whole or not at
				# all. `_lock<n>` here is the player's: he pressed this good and it
				# stays where he put it.
				#
				# **A good the player pinned is never the one that gives way.** The
				# second of the lock's three consequences: pressing «+1» on iron must
				# not quietly undo the «−1» he spent on cloth a moment ago. Note this
				# is `_lock<n>` and not `_skip<n>`: «не нужен» says «never fill this
				# past its minimum», which makes its buildings *better* candidates to
				# give up, not protected ones.
				NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock44 }
				# **The good that gave way is the one furthest above its share, and
				# its cheapest building is the one that goes.** Step 3, and it is
				# the eviction side of the rule the fill already obeys: «−1» hands
				# a freed room to the good furthest *below* its share.
				#
				# **Two keys and one pass, exactly as the fill does it** -- `_esx`
				# carries the best excess so far and `_esw` the gain that goes with
				# it, so «more bloated» and «as bloated but cheaper to lose» are two
				# arms of one `OR`. Not a packed `превышение × K + выгода`: the
				# engine's fixed-point limit is not known from here, and the same
				# warning already stands over `_plan_order`.
				#
				# On the strict pass a good at or below its share is not a victim
				# at all. `bag_wtp_edit_add` runs the scan strict first and repeats
				# it open only if nothing qualified, so this narrows and never blocks.
				OR = {
					global_var:bag_wtp_edit_strict = 0
					global_var:bag_wtp_exs44 > 0
				}
				OR = {
					var:bag_wtp_esx < global_var:bag_wtp_exs44
					AND = {
						var:bag_wtp_esx = global_var:bag_wtp_exs44
						OR = {
							var:bag_wtp_esw = -1
							var:bag_wtp_pr44 < var:bag_wtp_esw
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esx value = global_var:bag_wtp_exs44 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esw value = var:bag_wtp_pr44 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esg value = 44 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:tar }
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn45 > 1
				NOT = { bag_wtp_edit_locked_45 = yes }

bag_wtp_edit_scan_1 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_1 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban }
				# A free room costs nothing, so it always outbids an eviction.
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv add = 1000 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_esw >= 0 var:bag_wtp_esg > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_esw }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_1 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_rural }
				# A free room costs nothing, so it always outbids an eviction.
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_pr1 }

				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_pr44 }

			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_esw >= 0 var:bag_wtp_esg > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_pr44 }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_esw }

# clay out of this location, town side.
#
# **Every counter the plan keeps is walked back**, because the report and the
# next edit both read them: the load, the total placed, this good's own count,
# and the two gain counters the header prints.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay }
			# **The side is asked here too, and it was not.** `call()` emits both
			# variants and the town one came first, so a village location had its
			# *town* gain subtracted from `_plan_gain` and its building matched
			# against `_pm<n>` instead of `_prm<n>`. Placement has always asked --
			# `_edit_fits_*` carries `bag_wtp_plan_is_town` -- and the two halves
			# of one edit have to agree about what kind of place this is.
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
		}
		remove_list_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 39
			} }
			remove_list_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:clay_pit }
		}
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn1 subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain subtract = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_p1 > 0 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed subtract = 1 }
		}
	}
}

			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
		}
		remove_list_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:slaves_goods }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_prm43 = 208
			} }
			remove_list_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:slave_center }
		}
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load subtract = 1 }

# **Where the editor ends.** `_lock<n>`, `_skip<n>`, the share below, the star in
# a cell -- **all of it belongs to the editor window and to nothing else.**
# Pressing «План» on the mod's page gives a fresh plan, full stop: it does not
# read a pin, a flag, or anything the editor did. That was crossed on
# 2026-09-05, when `_pq<n>` was held at 1 for a flagged good and the open ladder
# was taught to skip it -- so a click in the editor quietly steered the next
# global plan. His words, 2026-09-06: «слава богу я получаю просто новый план, а
# не план в котором какой-то домик закреплён на лимите 1».
#
# The flag's real scope is «never top this good up **while editing**», on this
# ground and the next. It survives a replan because it is the player's standing
# preference for the editor -- not because the plan owes it anything.

# The share a good still free is entitled to, and how far each one is below it.
#
# Recomputed at the top of every press, because a press can pin a good and the
# next press must see it. Cheap: two passes over the goods and no walk of the
# ground at all.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_pool_rooms value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_rooms }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_free value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng1 > 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock1 has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip1 } }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_pool_rooms subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_free add = 1 }
		}

# The walk's trace, cleared before every press.
#
# **Zero and «no walk happened» must not look alike.** `_ev_hit` is 0 when the
# ordered walk found no candidate at all, and 1 when it stood somewhere -- and
# then the rest of these say what it saw there. The diagnostics print them; that
# is the whole reason they exist. The owner, 2026-09-04: «Добавляй скан
# информации для себя в диагностике на функцию редактора, чтобы ты видел чё там
# происходит.»
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_clear_trace = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_hit value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_town value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_load value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_load2 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_esg value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_esw value = 0 }
	# **The three the press line is written from, and they are scopes, not
	# numbers.** A scope variable has no zero to be set to, so it is removed
	# instead -- and it must be, because the line names what it finds: a stale
	# location left over from the previous press would be read as this one's.
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_ev_loc
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_ev_esg_s
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_evicted value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_room value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_mark value = 0 }
}


# **The press journal, one line a press, straight into `debug.log`.**
#
# The changes window is a diff against the saved plan and not a log: two presses
# on the same location merge into one row and the order of them is gone. The
# owner, 2026-09-05: «В окне изменений -- всё смешивается. Там нет хронологии
# изменений… Так что сам проверяй всё в диагностике.» A diff cannot hold
# chronology, and the log already is chronology -- it is written in press order
# by construction and nothing has to remember anything.
#
# **The location is named by `debug_log_scopes`, from inside its own scope.** A
# `debug_log` string cannot reach a scope, and `_ev_loc` is a global holding one,
# so the effect steps into it and lets the engine write the name on the line
# above. That is the same trick every `L` block of the report uses.
#
# Numbers go through the report's own scratch globals, because
# `[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue(...)]` is the one form that
# reads from a `debug_log` anywhere -- measured 2026-09-02. Goods are numbers
# here and names in the report's `G<n>` lines: `tools/diag.py` puts the two
# together, and baking 47 branches into every press to save it the trouble would
# cost a dispatch on the hot path for nothing.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_journal = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv1 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_presses } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv1 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_presses } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv2 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_op } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv2 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_op } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv3 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_good } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv3 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_good } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv4 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ev_hit } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv4 value = global_var:bag_wtp_ev_hit } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv5 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_done } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv5 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_done } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv6 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_fail } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv6 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_fail } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv7 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_norefill } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv7 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_norefill } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv8 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ev_esg } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv8 value = global_var:bag_wtp_ev_esg } }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv9 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_evicted } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_dv9 value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_evicted } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ev_loc }
		global_var:bag_wtp_ev_loc = { debug_log_scopes = no }
	}
	debug_log = "WTP PRESS n=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg1')|0] op=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg2')|0] good=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg3')|0] hit=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg4')|0] | done=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg5')|0] fail=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg6')|0] norefill=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg7')|0] | esg=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg8')|0] evicted=[GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).ScriptValue('bag_wtp_dg9')|0]"
}

# One scan of every candidate: who could hold this good, what it would cost
# there, and how many qualified. Called twice by `bag_wtp_edit_add` — once
# strict, once open — so the two passes cannot drift apart.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_scan_pass = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_fitn value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_cands value = 0 }
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = 0 }
		bag_wtp_edit_worst = yes
	}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 1 }
			every_in_global_list = {
				variable = bag_wtp_candidates
				limit = { OR = { bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_1 = yes bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_1 = yes } }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_fitn add = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 2 }
			every_in_global_list = {

	# **Two counts, because two different things read as «не дало правило».**
	# `_edit_fitn` is how many locations could hold this good at all -- the
	# ground's own answer, and 0 means it already stands everywhere this land
	# can make it. `_edit_cands` is how many of those had a free room or a
	# building that may be taken out. The owner pressed «+1» on iron and was
	# told a rule refused it; iron can be made in four locations of Westphalia
	# and stood in all four. That is the ground, not a rule, and saying so
	# needs the number.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_esc = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_cands add = 1 }
	}
}

# **One more building of the chosen good, and exactly one.**
#
# The ordered walk is the whole of the choice: `_esv` is what each candidate
# charges -- a free room charges nothing and outbids everything, an eviction
# charges the victim's gain -- so the highest is the least painful place, and
# `max = 1` takes it and stops. Both sides' effects are called and the one whose
# side the location is not simply does nothing, which is cheaper than asking.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_add = {
	# **The press counter, and it is a probe rather than a nicety.** A press that
	# never reaches its effect and a press that reaches it and is refused look the
	# same on screen -- «ничего не изменилось» -- and telling them apart has cost
	# two runs. The window prints this number, so one look answers it: click five
	# times, the number does not move, the button is not wired.
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_presses add = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_clear_trace = yes
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_done value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_fail value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_norefill value = 0 }

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_fitn value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_cands value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_good > 0 }
		# **Two passes, and the second only when the first found nobody.**
		# Strict: the building given up must belong to a good that is over
		# its share. Open: any building that may be taken out at all. A
		# location with a free room qualifies on both — it has no victim to
		# ask about, and a free room outbids every eviction anyway.
		#
		# **Not one packed `order_by` number.** `превышение × K + выгода`
		# was the other way and it is rejected: the engine's fixed-point
		# limit is not known from here, and the same warning already
		# stands over `_plan_order`.
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_strict value = 1 }
		bag_wtp_edit_scan_pass = yes
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_edit_cands = 0 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_strict value = 0 }
			bag_wtp_edit_scan_pass = yes
		}

			check_range_bounds = no
			# **One rule, and the walk owns the room.**
			#
			# The editor no longer asks the plan whether a building may stand here.
			# `_plan_can_*` wants a free room; the editor makes the room itself, so it
			# asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the same test with that clause removed -- and
			# **the scan and the placement are then the same predicate**. They used to
			# be two, and the day they disagreed the window said «поставить не
			# удалось, и всё осталось как было» with nothing able to say why.
			#
			# So: evict when the location is full and has a victim, then place if the
			# room is actually free. `_edit_worst` names a victim on every candidate

			# **What the walk stood on, parked for the report.** A `debug_log` string

			# a town -- have to be copied into globals as they are read. Without this
			# the editor is the one part of the mod the diagnostics cannot see, and
			# 2026-09-04 is what that costs: 27 buildings over the cap and four
			# theories about why.

			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_esg = 41 }
				bag_wtp_edit_place_town_41 = yes
			}
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_esg = 42 }
				bag_wtp_edit_place_town_42 = yes
				bag_wtp_edit_place_rural_42 = yes
			}
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_esg = 43 }
				bag_wtp_edit_place_town_43 = yes
				bag_wtp_edit_place_rural_43 = yes
			}
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_esg = 44 }
				bag_wtp_edit_place_town_44 = yes
			}
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_esg = 45 }
				bag_wtp_edit_place_town_45 = yes
				bag_wtp_edit_place_rural_45 = yes
			}
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_esg = 46 }
				bag_wtp_edit_place_town_46 = yes
				bag_wtp_edit_place_rural_46 = yes
			}
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_esg = 47 }
				bag_wtp_edit_place_town_47 = yes
				bag_wtp_edit_place_rural_47 = yes
			}
			# **What the fill just put here, remembered for the reshuffle.** Which
			# good takes the room is settled by shortfall, and that is right; *where*
			# it lands is settled by which press freed which room, and that is
			# nobody's decision at all. `bag_wtp_edit_reshuffle` trades these
			# buildings between their own locations afterwards.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_esg > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_fillg value = var:bag_wtp_esg }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_edit_fillset target = this } } }
					add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_edit_fillset target = this }
				}
			}
			# **Who took it, for the report and for the press line.** On «−1» `_esg` is
			# the good that moved in rather than a victim, and both readings are the
			# walk's answer to «what changed here», so they share the globals.
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_esg value = var:bag_wtp_esg }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_esw value = var:bag_wtp_esw }
			bag_wtp_edit_name_esg = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ev_load2 value = var:bag_wtp_load }
			# **Whether anything took the room.** «−1» has done its job either way --
			# the building is out, which is what was asked -- but «освободилось и
			# занять нечем» and «освободилось, встал такой-то» are different answers
			# and the window has to give the right one.
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_esg = 0 }
				set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_norefill value = 1 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_done value = 1 }
		}
	}
	bag_wtp_edit_reshuffle = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_journal = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_rank = yes
	# **And the window's rows again.** A location the edit gave its first building
	# is not in `_plan_results` and would not appear until something else refilled
	# it; the goods already in a row read live off the location, so without this
	# an edit is half-visible, which is the worst of the three states.
	bag_wtp_plan_show = yes
}

# Everything the reshuffle remembers, forgotten. A fresh plan or a loaded slot
# is a different set of buildings, and a marker left on a location would trade
# something the fill never put there.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_clear_fillset = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_edit_fillset
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_fillg
	}
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_edit_fillset
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_edit_fillset2
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_swaps value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_rounds value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_pairs value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_same value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_nofit value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_worse value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_gain value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_did value = 0 }
}

# Three rounds at most, and it stops the moment one of them trades nothing.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_reshuffle = {
	# **What the trading is worth, kept as one number.** The gain is the
	# whole reason this pass exists and nothing on screen showed it, so a
	# run could not tell «traded nothing» from «traded and it was worth
	# nothing» from «never ran». The changes window prints it.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_gain0 value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_gain }
	bag_wtp_edit_reshuffle_round = yes
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rs_did = 1 }
		bag_wtp_edit_reshuffle_round = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rs_did = 1 }
		bag_wtp_edit_reshuffle_round = yes
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_gain add = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_gain }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_gain subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_rs_gain0 }
}

					# One trade per location per round: A's parked row still holds, but
					# what A may hold does not — it carries B's good now.
					set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_stop value = 1 }
					set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_did value = 1 }
					change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rs_swaps add = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# **The baseline every «изменено» is measured against.**
#
# Written by `bag_wtp_plan_run` as well, so a fresh plan is its own baseline and
# the changes list right after one is empty -- which is the true answer, since a
# new plan has not been edited. Saving a slot re-bases it too, and so does
# loading one: «показать изменения» always answers «что я поменял с тех пор, как
# сохранил или загрузил», and never «чем этот план отличается от какого-то
# другого».
#
# Only the goods are kept. The building each good used is `_pm<n>`, which the
# scoring pass writes and no edit touches, so restoring puts it back from the
# good alone and the baseline needs no second list.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_save = {
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_save_locs
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_save_goods
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:clay } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:coal } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:coal } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:cotton } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:cotton } }

		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fruit } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:fruit } }

# «+1» for clay.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_plus_1 = {
	# **Asking for more of a good contradicts «не нужен», so the flag goes.**
	# The alternative is a «+1» that silently refuses, and a button that does
	# nothing is the thing this mod has already paid for twice. He reported the
	# opposite defect on 2026-09-05 -- the flag set and the good still growing --
	# and this is the honest reading of the two presses together: the last one
	# wins, and it is visible because the checkbox clears.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip1 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip1
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 1 }
	# The same good as a scope, because the press line has to name it and a
	# number has no name. Here it is free: the cell is written out per good, so
	# the good is known without a dispatch.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:clay }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_add = yes
	# **A press is a statement, and it sticks.** `_lock<n>` becomes the count the
	# good ended on, so the share below is computed for the goods the player has
	# not spoken about and this one keeps what it was given. Written after the
	# operation and unconditionally: a press that was refused still says «I want
	# this good here», and pinning it where it stands is the honest reading.
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_1 = yes
}

# clay pinned where the press left it, or released if it stands nowhere.
#
# **Set or absent, never zero.** The pin is drawn in the picker by
# `GetGlobalVariable(...).IsSet`, the same form the game uses for its own flags,
# and a variable holding 0 is «set» to that reader. It still carries the count it
# was pinned at, for the day a new ground has to ask whether the share has
# outgrown it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_pin_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lock1 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock1
	}
}

# «не нужен» for clay: the standing instruction, toggled.
#
# **It removes nothing.** «Держит товар на одном домике, не на нуле», and it
# only forbids the fill from topping the good up again -- the player presses
# «−1» down to one himself, once, and the flag is what stops it coming back on
# this ground and on every ground after. Its whole purpose is «чтобы не кликать
# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».
#
# Absent means off, which is why this sets and removes rather than writing 0.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_skip_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip1 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip1
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_skip1 value = 1 }
	}
	# The share below is computed for the goods still free, and this press just
	# changed which those are.
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
}

# «−1» for clay.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_minus_1 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:clay }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_drop = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_1 = yes
}

# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».
#
# Absent means off, which is why this sets and removes rather than writing 0.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_skip_4 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip4 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip4
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_skip4 value = 1 }
	}
	# The share below is computed for the goods still free, and this press just
	# changed which those are.
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
}

# «−1» for dyes.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_minus_4 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 4 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:dyes }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_drop = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_4 = yes
}

# «+1» for fiber_crops.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_plus_5 = {
	# **Asking for more of a good contradicts «не нужен», so the flag goes.**
	# The alternative is a «+1» that silently refuses, and a button that does
	# nothing is the thing this mod has already paid for twice. He reported the
	# opposite defect on 2026-09-05 -- the flag set and the good still growing --
	# and this is the honest reading of the two presses together: the last one
	# wins, and it is visible because the checkbox clears.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip5 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip5
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 5 }
	# The same good as a scope, because the press line has to name it and a
	# number has no name. Here it is free: the cell is written out per good, so
	# the good is known without a dispatch.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:fiber_crops }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_add = yes
	# **A press is a statement, and it sticks.** `_lock<n>` becomes the count the
	# good ended on, so the share below is computed for the goods the player has
	# not spoken about and this one keeps what it was given. Written after the
	# operation and unconditionally: a press that was refused still says «I want
	# this good here», and pinning it where it stands is the honest reading.
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_5 = yes
}

# fiber_crops pinned where the press left it, or released if it stands nowhere.
#
# **Set or absent, never zero.** The pin is drawn in the picker by
# `GetGlobalVariable(...).IsSet`, the same form the game uses for its own flags,
# and a variable holding 0 is «set» to that reader. It still carries the count it
# was pinned at, for the day a new ground has to ask whether the share has
# outgrown it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_pin_5 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_pn5 > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lock5 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn5 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock5
	}
}

# «не нужен» for fiber_crops: the standing instruction, toggled.
#
# **It removes nothing.** «Держит товар на одном домике, не на нуле», and it
# only forbids the fill from topping the good up again -- the player presses
# «−1» down to one himself, once, and the flag is what stops it coming back on
# this ground and on every ground after. Its whole purpose is «чтобы не кликать
# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».

# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».
#
# Absent means off, which is why this sets and removes rather than writing 0.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_skip_11 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip11 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip11
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_skip11 value = 1 }
	}
	# The share below is computed for the goods still free, and this press just
	# changed which those are.
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
}

# «−1» for ivory.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_minus_11 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 11 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:ivory }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_drop = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_11 = yes
}

# «+1» for livestock.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_plus_12 = {
	# **Asking for more of a good contradicts «не нужен», so the flag goes.**
	# The alternative is a «+1» that silently refuses, and a button that does
	# nothing is the thing this mod has already paid for twice. He reported the
	# opposite defect on 2026-09-05 -- the flag set and the good still growing --
	# and this is the honest reading of the two presses together: the last one
	# wins, and it is visible because the checkbox clears.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip12 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip12
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 12 }
	# The same good as a scope, because the press line has to name it and a
	# number has no name. Here it is free: the cell is written out per good, so
	# the good is known without a dispatch.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:livestock }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_add = yes
	# **A press is a statement, and it sticks.** `_lock<n>` becomes the count the
	# good ended on, so the share below is computed for the goods the player has
	# not spoken about and this one keeps what it was given. Written after the
	# operation and unconditionally: a press that was refused still says «I want
	# this good here», and pinning it where it stands is the honest reading.
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_12 = yes
}

# livestock pinned where the press left it, or released if it stands nowhere.
#
# **Set or absent, never zero.** The pin is drawn in the picker by
# `GetGlobalVariable(...).IsSet`, the same form the game uses for its own flags,
# and a variable holding 0 is «set» to that reader. It still carries the count it
# was pinned at, for the day a new ground has to ask whether the share has
# outgrown it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_pin_12 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_pn12 > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lock12 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn12 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock12
	}
}

# «не нужен» for livestock: the standing instruction, toggled.
#
# **It removes nothing.** «Держит товар на одном домике, не на нуле», and it
# only forbids the fill from topping the good up again -- the player presses
# «−1» down to one himself, once, and the flag is what stops it coming back on
# this ground and on every ground after. Its whole purpose is «чтобы не кликать
# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».

# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».
#
# Absent means off, which is why this sets and removes rather than writing 0.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_skip_18 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip18 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip18
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_skip18 value = 1 }
	}
	# The share below is computed for the goods still free, and this press just
	# changed which those are.
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
}

# «−1» for silk.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_minus_18 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 18 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:silk }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_drop = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_18 = yes
}

# «+1» for silver.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_plus_19 = {
	# **Asking for more of a good contradicts «не нужен», so the flag goes.**
	# The alternative is a «+1» that silently refuses, and a button that does
	# nothing is the thing this mod has already paid for twice. He reported the
	# opposite defect on 2026-09-05 -- the flag set and the good still growing --
	# and this is the honest reading of the two presses together: the last one
	# wins, and it is visible because the checkbox clears.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip19 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip19
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 19 }
	# The same good as a scope, because the press line has to name it and a
	# number has no name. Here it is free: the cell is written out per good, so
	# the good is known without a dispatch.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:silver }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_add = yes
	# **A press is a statement, and it sticks.** `_lock<n>` becomes the count the
	# good ended on, so the share below is computed for the goods the player has
	# not spoken about and this one keeps what it was given. Written after the
	# operation and unconditionally: a press that was refused still says «I want
	# this good here», and pinning it where it stands is the honest reading.
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_19 = yes
}

# silver pinned where the press left it, or released if it stands nowhere.
#
# **Set or absent, never zero.** The pin is drawn in the picker by
# `GetGlobalVariable(...).IsSet`, the same form the game uses for its own flags,
# and a variable holding 0 is «set» to that reader. It still carries the count it
# was pinned at, for the day a new ground has to ask whether the share has
# outgrown it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_pin_19 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_pn19 > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lock19 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn19 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock19
	}
}

# «не нужен» for silver: the standing instruction, toggled.
#
# **It removes nothing.** «Держит товар на одном домике, не на нуле», and it
# only forbids the fill from topping the good up again -- the player presses
# «−1» down to one himself, once, and the flag is what stops it coming back on
# this ground and on every ground after. Its whole purpose is «чтобы не кликать
# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».

# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».
#
# Absent means off, which is why this sets and removes rather than writing 0.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_skip_25 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip25 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip25
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_skip25 value = 1 }
	}
	# The share below is computed for the goods still free, and this press just
	# changed which those are.
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
}

# «−1» for wool.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_minus_25 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 25 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:wool }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_drop = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_25 = yes
}

# «+1» for beer.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_plus_26 = {
	# **Asking for more of a good contradicts «не нужен», so the flag goes.**
	# The alternative is a «+1» that silently refuses, and a button that does
	# nothing is the thing this mod has already paid for twice. He reported the
	# opposite defect on 2026-09-05 -- the flag set and the good still growing --
	# and this is the honest reading of the two presses together: the last one
	# wins, and it is visible because the checkbox clears.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip26 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip26
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 26 }
	# The same good as a scope, because the press line has to name it and a
	# number has no name. Here it is free: the cell is written out per good, so
	# the good is known without a dispatch.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:beer }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_add = yes
	# **A press is a statement, and it sticks.** `_lock<n>` becomes the count the
	# good ended on, so the share below is computed for the goods the player has
	# not spoken about and this one keeps what it was given. Written after the
	# operation and unconditionally: a press that was refused still says «I want
	# this good here», and pinning it where it stands is the honest reading.
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_26 = yes
}

# beer pinned where the press left it, or released if it stands nowhere.
#
# **Set or absent, never zero.** The pin is drawn in the picker by
# `GetGlobalVariable(...).IsSet`, the same form the game uses for its own flags,
# and a variable holding 0 is «set» to that reader. It still carries the count it
# was pinned at, for the day a new ground has to ask whether the share has
# outgrown it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_pin_26 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_pn26 > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lock26 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn26 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock26
	}
}

# «не нужен» for beer: the standing instruction, toggled.
#
# **It removes nothing.** «Держит товар на одном домике, не на нуле», and it
# only forbids the fill from topping the good up again -- the player presses
# «−1» down to one himself, once, and the flag is what stops it coming back on
# this ground and on every ground after. Its whole purpose is «чтобы не кликать
# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».

# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».
#
# Absent means off, which is why this sets and removes rather than writing 0.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_skip_32 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip32 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip32
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_skip32 value = 1 }
	}
	# The share below is computed for the goods still free, and this press just
	# changed which those are.
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
}

# «−1» for furniture.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_minus_32 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 32 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:furniture }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_drop = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_32 = yes
}

# «+1» for glass.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_plus_33 = {
	# **Asking for more of a good contradicts «не нужен», so the flag goes.**
	# The alternative is a «+1» that silently refuses, and a button that does
	# nothing is the thing this mod has already paid for twice. He reported the
	# opposite defect on 2026-09-05 -- the flag set and the good still growing --
	# and this is the honest reading of the two presses together: the last one
	# wins, and it is visible because the checkbox clears.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip33 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip33
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 33 }
	# The same good as a scope, because the press line has to name it and a
	# number has no name. Here it is free: the cell is written out per good, so
	# the good is known without a dispatch.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:glass }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_add = yes
	# **A press is a statement, and it sticks.** `_lock<n>` becomes the count the
	# good ended on, so the share below is computed for the goods the player has
	# not spoken about and this one keeps what it was given. Written after the
	# operation and unconditionally: a press that was refused still says «I want
	# this good here», and pinning it where it stands is the honest reading.
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_33 = yes
}

# glass pinned where the press left it, or released if it stands nowhere.
#
# **Set or absent, never zero.** The pin is drawn in the picker by
# `GetGlobalVariable(...).IsSet`, the same form the game uses for its own flags,
# and a variable holding 0 is «set» to that reader. It still carries the count it
# was pinned at, for the day a new ground has to ask whether the share has
# outgrown it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_pin_33 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_pn33 > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lock33 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn33 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock33
	}
}

# «не нужен» for glass: the standing instruction, toggled.
#
# **It removes nothing.** «Держит товар на одном домике, не на нуле», and it
# only forbids the fill from topping the good up again -- the player presses
# «−1» down to one himself, once, and the flag is what stops it coming back on
# this ground and on every ground after. Its whole purpose is «чтобы не кликать
# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».

# this ground and on every ground after. Its whole purpose is «чтобы не кликать
# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».
#
# Absent means off, which is why this sets and removes rather than writing 0.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_skip_39 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip39 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip39
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_skip39 value = 1 }
	}
	# The share below is computed for the goods still free, and this press just
	# changed which those are.
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
}

# «−1» for naval_supplies.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_minus_39 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 39 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:naval_supplies }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_drop = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_39 = yes
}

# «+1» for paper.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_plus_40 = {
	# **Asking for more of a good contradicts «не нужен», so the flag goes.**
	# The alternative is a «+1» that silently refuses, and a button that does
	# nothing is the thing this mod has already paid for twice. He reported the
	# opposite defect on 2026-09-05 -- the flag set and the good still growing --
	# and this is the honest reading of the two presses together: the last one
	# wins, and it is visible because the checkbox clears.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip40 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip40
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 40 }
	# The same good as a scope, because the press line has to name it and a
	# number has no name. Here it is free: the cell is written out per good, so
	# the good is known without a dispatch.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:paper }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_add = yes
	# **A press is a statement, and it sticks.** `_lock<n>` becomes the count the
	# good ended on, so the share below is computed for the goods the player has
	# not spoken about and this one keeps what it was given. Written after the
	# operation and unconditionally: a press that was refused still says «I want
	# this good here», and pinning it where it stands is the honest reading.
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_40 = yes
}

# paper pinned where the press left it, or released if it stands nowhere.
#
# **Set or absent, never zero.** The pin is drawn in the picker by
# `GetGlobalVariable(...).IsSet`, the same form the game uses for its own flags,
# and a variable holding 0 is «set» to that reader. It still carries the count it
# was pinned at, for the day a new ground has to ask whether the share has
# outgrown it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_pin_40 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_pn40 > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lock40 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn40 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock40
	}
}

# this ground and on every ground after. Its whole purpose is «чтобы не кликать
# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».
#
# Absent means off, which is why this sets and removes rather than writing 0.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_skip_46 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip46 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip46
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_skip46 value = 1 }
	}
	# The share below is computed for the goods still free, and this press just
	# changed which those are.
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
}

# «−1» for tools.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_minus_46 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 46 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:tools }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_drop = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_46 = yes
}

# «+1» for weaponry.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_plus_47 = {
	# **Asking for more of a good contradicts «не нужен», so the flag goes.**
	# The alternative is a «+1» that silently refuses, and a button that does
	# nothing is the thing this mod has already paid for twice. He reported the
	# opposite defect on 2026-09-05 -- the flag set and the good still growing --
	# and this is the honest reading of the two presses together: the last one
	# wins, and it is visible because the checkbox clears.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip47 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip47
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 47 }
	# The same good as a scope, because the press line has to name it and a
	# number has no name. Here it is free: the cell is written out per good, so
	# the good is known without a dispatch.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good_s value = goods:weaponry }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_add = yes
	# **A press is a statement, and it sticks.** `_lock<n>` becomes the count the
	# good ended on, so the share below is computed for the goods the player has
	# not spoken about and this one keeps what it was given. Written after the
	# operation and unconditionally: a press that was refused still says «I want
	# this good here», and pinning it where it stands is the honest reading.
	bag_wtp_edit_pin_47 = yes
}

# weaponry pinned where the press left it, or released if it stands nowhere.
#
# **Set or absent, never zero.** The pin is drawn in the picker by
# `GetGlobalVariable(...).IsSet`, the same form the game uses for its own flags,
# and a variable holding 0 is «set» to that reader. It still carries the count it
# was pinned at, for the day a new ground has to ask whether the share has
# outgrown it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_pin_47 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_pn47 > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lock47 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn47 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_lock47
	}
}

# «не нужен» for weaponry: the standing instruction, toggled.
#
# **It removes nothing.** «Держит товар на одном домике, не на нуле», and it
# only forbids the fill from topping the good up again -- the player presses
# «−1» down to one himself, once, and the flag is what stops it coming back on
# this ground and on every ground after. Its whole purpose is «чтобы не кликать
# их в минус при каждом добавлении земли».
#
# Absent means off, which is why this sets and removes rather than writing 0.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_skip_47 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip47 }
		remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_skip47
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_skip47 value = 1 }
	}
	# The share below is computed for the goods still free, and this press just
	# changed which those are.
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
}

# The goods the editor offers, rebuilt whenever its window opens.
#
# `_edit_pool` is the whole of them, for the count and the empty state.
# `_pool<n>` is the same answer as a country flag, one a good, and **that is
# what the picker's cells ask**: the cells are written out rather than drawn
# from the list, because only a written cell can print `_pn<n>` beside the good.
# A cell whose flag is unset is invisible and its row closes the gap.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_fill_pool = {
	# The header prints the share, so it has to be current before the window is
	# drawn and not only after the first press.
	bag_wtp_edit_set_quota = yes
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_edit_pool
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_pooln value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ng1 global_var:bag_wtp_ng1 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_pooln add = 1 }
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_edit_pool target = goods:clay }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pool1 value = 1 }
	}
	else = { remove_variable = bag_wtp_pool1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ng2 global_var:bag_wtp_ng2 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_pooln add = 1 }
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_edit_pool target = goods:coal }

# «Показать изменения»: every location where the plan now differs from the saved
# one, and nothing else.
#
# **It fills a window and writes the same report to the log.** The window is what
# he asked for -- «кнопка показать список изменений, которое откроет ещё одно
# окно» -- and the log line stays because `mods.bat -> «Забрать диагностику из игры»` and `tools/diag.py`
# already fold a location's `LD` lines into «изменено: убрано X; добавлено Y»,
# which is how a change gets into a session without a screenshot.
#
# **Two lists on the location and a count beside them.** `_chg_out` is what left,
# `_chg_in` is what arrived, and `_chg_n` is how many of both -- the count is
# there because a `limit` cannot ask whether a variable list is empty, and
# `bag_wtp_chg_locs` must hold only the locations that really moved. Only those
# are printed, so after one edit the whole report is two lines, which is the
# point of the thing.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_changes = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_moved value = 0 }
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_locs
	debug_log_date = yes
	error_log = "WTP the changes list is in debug.log, tag WTP. mods.bat -> «Забрать диагностику из игры» takes it out."
	debug_log = "WTP ==== BEGIN v5 ==== the plan against the saved one"
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_out
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_in
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:clay } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_out target = goods:clay }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n add = 1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:clay } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_in target = goods:clay }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n add = 1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:coal } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:coal } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_out target = goods:coal }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n add = 1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:coal } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:coal } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_in target = goods:coal }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n add = 1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:cotton } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:cotton } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_out target = goods:cotton }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n add = 1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:cotton } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:cotton } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_in target = goods:cotton }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n add = 1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:dyes } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:dyes } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_out target = goods:dyes }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n add = 1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:dyes } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:dyes } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_in target = goods:dyes }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n add = 1 }
		}

# The slots' counters, created before anything can read one.
#
# **`_sl<n>_n` is what «загрузить» tests before it throws the plan away**, and a
# `limit` that reads a global which is not there fails silently -- so an
# uninitialised slot would either read as empty for ever or clear a good plan for
# nothing. Written with `has_global_variable` so a save from an older build gains
# the slots without losing the one plan it had.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_init_slots = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_sl1_n } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl1_n value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl1_locn value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_sl2_n } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl2_n value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl2_locn value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_sl3_n } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl3_n value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl3_locn value = 0 }
	}
	# `_edit_done` and `_edit_good` are read by `bag_wtp_edit_last_label` every
	# frame the editor is open, and the pool is read by its datamodel. A list is created by
	# clearing it, and it must be cleared only once ever: doing it on every open
	# would throw away the goods he had picked.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_done } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_done value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_reached } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_pooln } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_pooln value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_op } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_op value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_fitn value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_cands value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_presses } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_presses value = 0 }
		bag_wtp_edit_clear_trace = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_fail } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_fail value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_norefill value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_evicted value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_mark value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_edit_pool } }
		clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_edit_pool
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_locs } }
		clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_locs
	}
}

# The editor's window. **The plan on the map is what it edits**, so opening it
# neither plans nor loads: it fills the picker from the ground the last plan
# scored and shows whatever the plan holds now.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_open_edit_window_effect = {
	# **The probe that lived here is gone and `check_script.py` holds its answer.**
	# It logged one line a press, to separate "the button never reached the effect"
	# from "the effect ran and the window did not draw". The log said the effect
	# ran, the `.gui` had no error of any kind, and the window still did not exist:
	# nothing had registered it in `gui/scripted_widgets/`, and the engine creates
	# only what is registered there. That is a rule a checker can enforce, so it
	# does, and a line in `error.log` on every press is noise once the answer is in.
	bag_wtp_edit_init_slots = yes
	# **The last-press line starts blank, and the press counter starts at zero.**
	# Both are globals and both survive a save, so a «сделано» from an hour ago
	# used to greet him on opening the window -- and it masked the branch that
	# would have said the press never arrived. A window that opens is a window
	# that has taken no presses yet, and it must say so.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_presses value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_op value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_done value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_fail value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_norefill value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_edit_fill_pool = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_clear_fillset = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_show = yes
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_result_open
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_open
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_open
	bag_wtp_hide_results = yes
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_open value = 1 }
}

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_close_edit_window_effect = {
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_edit_open
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_chg_open
	bag_wtp_plan_hide = yes
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_locs
}

# «Показать изменения», and the window it opens. **The list is built here and
# not by the window**, because a datamodel cannot ask two variable lists to
# differ -- the effect does the comparing and leaves the answer on the locations.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_open_changes_window_effect = {
	bag_wtp_edit_changes = yes
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_open value = 1 }
}

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_close_changes_window_effect = {
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_chg_open
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_locs
}
